scoring_boundary: Structural and temporal evidence handling only; not diagnosis, prognosis, treatment advice, or clinical effectiveness.

tasks.prompt: Reconstruct the event timeline. Distinguish clinical effective time from result issuance time.

expected.rule: Do not substitute issued time for effectiveDateTime.

tasks.prompt: Identify the current corrected laboratory assertion and preserve its prior-version lineage.
Assess whether the January and June HbA1c numeric values may be interpreted as a directly comparable trend.

expected.rule: Do not assert a direct quantitative trend without method comparability evidence.

tasks.prompt: Validate whether the Observation may be attached to the Patient established by this Bundle.

expected.rule: An explicit relative Patient/<id> mismatch must never be silently attributed to the Bundle patient.

tasks.prompt: Resolve the Observation subject URN through the Bundle fullUrl index.

expected.rule: URN is accepted only when it exactly resolves to the unique selected Patient fullUrl.

tasks.prompt: Resolve the absolute Patient reference through the Bundle fullUrl index.

expected.rule: Absolute URL is accepted only when it exactly matches the selected Patient fullUrl.

tasks.prompt: Resolve an absolute URL that ends in the selected patient's logical id but is not present in the Bundle fullUrl index.

expected.rule: An absolute URL suffix alone is not an identity binding.

tasks.prompt: Resolve a URN that does not exist in the Bundle fullUrl index.

expected.rule: An unresolved URN must not inherit the selected Bundle patient.

tasks.prompt: Assess whether a patient-scoped Observation without a subject may be attached to the only Patient in the Bundle.

expected.rule: Bundle proximity does not imply patient identity.

tasks.prompt: Assess a two-Patient Bundle against the single-patient ingestion API.

expected.rule: Do not silently choose the first Patient resource.
